status: Exploratory amendment after negative C1; commit before new C2/C3 gate and full-cohort inference
authorization: User explicitly approved continuing with C2 and matched C3 despite the original history-alone stopping rule. This supersedes that rule for this amendment only. Do not rewrite the original protocol.
rationale: Dense history did not improve mean Dice; it may introduce distractors. Selective regional history remains untested on the full cohort. E2 already generated sparse masks on seq2/seq3 for engineering checks; this is NOT a prospective registration before all regional predictions or a held-out study.

fixed_settings.precision: FP32, no autocast; native BF16 memory writes unchanged
fixed_settings.dense_frames: Prompt and latest; shared prompt/latest counted once during warmup
fixed_settings.region_rule: Unchanged native256 mixed-cell labels; keep foreground interior, mixed boundary and exactly one-token outer background ring using unchanged author dilation
fixed_settings.temporal_slots: Unchanged E2: prompt slot6, nonconditioning age a uses min(a-1,5)
fixed_settings.parameters: No weights, widths, memory limit or confidence thresholds tuned

C2: Unchanged validated E2 region_long reading. Choose the maximal recent suffix of past nonconditioning frames fitting the older budget, capped at 32 total frames including dense prompt/latest. Stop at first overflowing older frame; finite zero-selected frames allowed.
C3: Replay C2's exact frame IDs and per-frame selected token counts at every read and every layer. Use unchanged Efficient-SAM2 create_mask_randperm for positions, deterministic per sequence/frame/seed. Prompt/latest remain full. Pointer counts match, but pointer values remain each arm's own native outputs. Do not copy C2 masks/features/pointers into C3.
causality_and_claim: C2 counts from frame i are used only on subsequent reads. At read t the C3 selector depends only on the past C2 allocation prefix, not C2's current/future prediction or any postprompt GT. Current C2 allocation is checked for matching only. This is a reference-trajectory-conditioned random ablation, not a standalone deployable baseline. Diverging model trajectories are expected.
gate: Complete seq2 and seq3. Fresh-model C2 twice; C3 twice for EACH of three seeds. Own-arm output, low-res mask, complete bank/cache fingerprints, selector bits and allocation must replay bit for bit. C2 must also match previously saved E2 region_long_0 core fingerprints. Check every read's four layers, exact captured native frame values, original RoPE, preserved pointer tails, actual gathered lengths <=28672, matching C2/C3 frame IDs and per-frame counts, unchanged parameters and complete chronology. No full-cohort inference until all gate receipts and W&B artifacts finish.
cohort: All 23 manifest sequences; seq1/seq7 are unpromptable N/A. One first-visible-frame GT mask prompt only. Full C2 then all three C3 seeds for each promptable sequence. No efficacy-based early stopping or retries.
references: Preserve and reuse completed C0/C1 from source23 only after validating source/checkpoint/manifest and successful delivery. No unnecessary baseline rerun. Verify matched target/present/absent counts per sequence.
primary: Equal-sequence present-frame Dice. Two fixed contrasts: C2-C0 and C2-mean(C3 seeds within sequence). Paired Wilcoxon, Holm correction across these two contrasts; separate 95% 10000-replicate whole-sequence bootstrap intervals (not simultaneous). Report all seeds and sequence results.
secondary: GT-empty false-alarm count/rate with per-sequence denominators
GT return episodes: first overlapping prediction delay and explicit censoring
actual selected spatial and pointer keys and query-key pairs over all four layers
attention-module wall time includes layer verification but excludes assembly and outer bank hashing; end-to-end rollout wall time also saved; not claimed isolated kernel speedup
source_reuse: Unchanged pinned E2 core plus Efficient-SAM2 8e1ad06089b9c958ff5ebfc72b9b7d0b904f5ce5 build_model/window_bypass.py create_mask_randperm. Project glue handles matched schedules, RNG isolation, metrics and logging; not claimed an unchanged author full model.
stopping: Stop on any integrity failure, never relax parity or matching. Unexpected or negative efficacy results remain reported, with no tuning. C4, SAMURAI+C2 and E4 are not launched. E4 remains explicitly deferred.
